admission.justification: Realized across root pyproject.toml and mcp/pyproject.toml, proved by PyreflyScopeConfigurationTests, and prevents reintroducing Pyright config or package drift that would split editor and hook type checking.

applicability: Repository-wide Python static type checking configured in root pyproject.toml and installed from mcp/pyproject.toml.
conditions: Root pyproject.toml configures [tool.pyrefly] as the sole Python type-checker section.
The mcp/pyproject.toml dev extra resolves pyrefly>=1.5.0,<2 and omits pyright.
exclusions: Legacy # pyright: ignore comments kept compatible via enabled-ignores rather than requiring bulk rewrites.
statement: Pyrefly configured in pyproject.toml under [tool.pyrefly] replaces [tool.pyright] across the whole tracked Python tree including .dagger/, with search-path, python-version 3.14, enabled-ignores [type, pyrefly, pyright], infer-with-first-use = false, check-unannotated-defs = false, infer-return-types = annotated, and unbound-name kept enabled.
title: Root [tool.pyrefly] and dev extra replace Pyright across tracked Python
